assessments.reasoning: Go 1.23 permits equality comparisons on statically compatible interface operands. Evaluating such a comparison panics when both operands carry the same dynamic type and that type lacks equality comparison.

limitations: Different dynamic types or a nil interface operand do not satisfy this condition. This does not make arbitrary equality expressions statically legal.
